title: PDL file does not exist
notes: Fixed (spec docs/error-reporting/specs/E-BOUNDARY.md). `parse_file` raises `PDLFileNotFoundError`, which is both a `PDLParseError` and a `FileNotFoundError`, so `generate` already prints it and every existing `except FileNotFoundError` around `exec_file` keeps matching. Location is capped at 1 and that is not a defect to fix later: the error is about the path itself, so there is no line, column or excerpt that could exist. Fix scores 1 on this branch because the work directory holds no other file; the near-miss branches (missing `.pdl` suffix, a close `difflib` match, a listing of the sibling `.pdl` files) score 3 and are exercised by tests/test_parse_errors.py.
